The season ran from 18 April to 22 November 1999. [[C.D. Primeiro de Agosto|Primeiro de Agosto]] were the defending champions. The league comprised 14 teams, the bottom three of which were relegated to the 2000 [[Gira Angola]]. [[C.D. Primeiro de Agosto|Primeiro de Agosto]] were crowned champions, winning their 8th title,{{cite web |url=http://www.portalangop.co.ao/angola/pt_pt/noticias/desporto/2000/10/45/,b4dd0ba4-7642-4901-a985-185a040feda5.html |title=O Petro-atletico de Luanda regressou asconquistas na divisão maior do futebol angolano |publisher=ANGOP.com |date= 6 Nov 2000 |access-date= 18 Sep 2015}} while [[Independente Sport Clube|Independente do Tômbwa]] and [[Progresso Associação do Sambizanga|Progresso do Sambizanga]], were relegated. Boelua Lokuli aka ''Isaac'' of [[C.D. Primeiro de Agosto|Primeiro de Agosto]] finished as the top scorer with 19 goals.{{cite web |url=http://www.portalangop.co.ao/angola/pt_pt/noticias/desporto/2012/10/44/Palmares-dos-melhores-marcadores-Girabola-desde-primeira-edicao-1979,71dde5ac-4401-49e8-9b52-b55df4f50592.html |title=Palmarés dos melhores marcadores do Girabola desde a primeira edição em 1979 |publisher=ANGOP.com |date=4 Nov 2012 |access-date=18 Sep 2015}} ==Changes from the 1998 season== '''Relegated:''' Chicoil, [[Kabuscorp S.C.P.|Kabuscorp]], SECIL
